cells.gaps: No ruling of the authority against a named organisation in the last three years has been found. The members were appointed in April 2021 for three years and no renewal has been found; an October 2026 source says the authority's activities are at a standstill, and none says its members have all left.
cells.note: Stage 3: the members appointed in 2021 stand until a source says they have all left, and the authority was still heard by parliament in February 2026. No ruling against a named organisation is held.
